title: How Lyft’s NVIDIA AI Integration and Freenow Deal At Lyft (LYFT) Has Changed Its Investment Story
title_zh: Lyft 的 NVIDIA AI 集成和 Lyft (LYFT) 的 Freenow 交易如何改变了其投资故事
summary: In March 2026, Lyft announced it will integrate NVIDIA’s AI technologies across its global operations to boost predictive modeling, mapping, and future Level 4 autonomous fleet architectures powered by NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion.
summary_zh: 2026 年 3 月，Lyft 宣布将在其全球运营中整合 NVIDIA 的 AI 技术，以增强预测建模、地图绘制以及由 NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion 提供支持的未来 4 级自动驾驶车队架构。

title: Constellation Energy To Sell PJM Portfolio Of Generation Assets In $5 Billion Deal
title_zh: Constellation Energy 将以 50 亿美元的价格出售 PJM 发电资产组合
summary: Constellation Energy shares are trending on Thursday. On Wednesday, the company disclosed that it is advancing its regulatory commitments through a significant asset sale.
summary_zh: 星座能源公司的股票周四呈现走势。周三，该公司透露，它正在通过一项重大资产出售来推进其监管承诺。

title: EA buyout debt draws $25 billion in orders as banks navigate volatile markets
title_zh: 银行应对动荡的市场，EA 收购债务吸引了 250 亿美元的订单
summary: Investing.com -- Investor demand for Electronic Arts Inc (NASDAQ:EA) nearly $15 billion debt offering has reached approximately $25 billion, a sign of resilient appetite for large-scale buyouts even as Wall Street banks struggle with a "white-knuckle" credit environment.
summary_zh: Investing.com——投资者对艺电公司（Electronic Arts Inc，纳斯达克股票代码：EA）近150亿美元债券发行的需求已达到约250亿美元，这表明即使华尔街银行在“紧张”的信贷环境中挣扎，人们对大规模收购的兴趣依然强劲。
